problem: The qualified shapes require bladePlasticBending and thrusterBladeLossDesignEvidence directly on steeringMechanism, thrusterFitting, and thrusterBody nodes, but both canonical properties have requiredOwner ship. This imposes constraints on the wrong RDF owners and also makes component-level evidence mandatory without an authorized component-owned path.
required_change: Remove the nested bladePlasticBending and thrusterBladeLossDesignEvidence constraints from all three component qualified shapes, or replace them with an explicitly canonical path whose required owner is the component; keep only the authorized ship-owned constraints unless such a path is supplied.
regression_guard: Preserve ship ownership for bladePlasticBending and thrusterBladeLossDesignEvidence and do not introduce direct property constraints on component nodes without canonical ownership support.
